import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Create the base shape
base = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0.0038).threePointArc((0.0011, 0.0011), (0.0038, 0.0)).lineTo(0.0191, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0218, 0.0011), (0.023, 0.0038)).lineTo(0.023, 0.0191).threePointArc((0.0218, 0.0218), (0.0191, 0.023)).lineTo(0.0038, 0.023).threePointArc((0.0011, 0.0218), (0.0, 0.0191)).close().extrude(0.75)

# Part 2: Create the top hole
top_hole = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0044, 0.0044).circle(0.0044).extrude(-0.0572, combine=False)

# Part 3: Create the side hole
side_hole = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0077, 0.0077).circle(0.0077).circle(0.0044).extrude(-0.0049, combine=False)

# Part 4: Create the top side hole
top_side_hole = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0044, 0.0044).circle(0.0044).extrude(-0.0306, combine=False)

# Part 5: Create the bottom side hole
bottom_side_hole = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0077, 0.0077).circle(0.0077).circle(0.0044).extrude(-0.0104, combine=False)

# Combine all parts
r = base.cut(top_hole).cut(side_hole).cut(top_side_hole).cut(bottom_side_hole)
